stem: Which conclusions are supported by BOTH the articles “Counting like the Maya” and “An Ancient Farming Method”?

options.text: The Maya and the Inca gained recognition by sharing details about their inventions with other cultures.
Because the Maya and the Inca spent most of their time trying to survive, they had little time for art and entertainment.
When the Maya and the Inca invented things, they likely used the natural environment as a source for ideas.
The Maya and the Inca influenced modern societies with their advanced ideas and problem-solving.
The Maya and the Inca first needed to understand basic math before they could undertake large construction projects.
